Read input: origen_005102.v · Open raw
module origen_005102 (
    input wire clock,
    input wire endata,
    input wire reset,
    input wire [3:0] spdmeanlen,
    input wire signed [18:0] phase,
    output reg signed [15:0] speed,
    output reg newAvg
);

    parameter N = 11;

    reg signed [31:0] acc;
    reg [N:0] counter;
    reg [2:0] state, nextstate;

    always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset)
            state <= 3'd0;
        else
            state <= nextstate;
    end

    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            3'd0: nextstate = endata ? 3'd1 : 3'd0;
            3'd1: nextstate = 3'd2;
            3'd2: nextstate = endata ? 3'd3 : 3'd2;
            3'd3: nextstate = (counter == 0) ? 3'd4 : 3'd2;
            3'd4: nextstate = 3'd2;
            default: nextstate = 3'd0;
        endcase
    end

    always @(posedge clock) begin
        case (state)
            3'd1: begin
                counter <= (1 << spdmeanlen) - 1;
                acc <= 0;
            end
            3'd3: begin
                acc <= acc + phase;
                counter <= counter - 1;
            end
            3'd4: begin
                speed <= ((acc >>> spdmeanlen) * 18026) >>> 17;
                newAvg <= 1'b1;
            end
            default: begin
                newAvg <= 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule
